heuristics: The deterministic r-adding class sequence behaves like independent uniform draws from the orbit classes until the first repeat (standard Pollard-rho random-walk heuristic).
The fixed 64-bit step-index mixer behaves as a random function.
The six-element automorphism orbit is exact, not a heuristic: beta^3=1 mod p, lambda^3=1 mod r, no nonzero point is fixed, and x=0 is off the curve.
A zero collision denominator occurs with probability O(1/r) and is counted as failure.
limitations: Analytic bound plus bounded toy and profile checks; no production execution or AArch64 instruction measurement.
Peak memory 2^135.001408 bytes is astronomical and mandatory for the full-storage collision search.
The random-walk and random-hash heuristics are not proved at production size; the 3.7% budget margin and the sensitivity figures in proof.md bound the disclosed uncertainty.
If the effective automorphism reduction were only 2x the ledger gives 2^128.334575; if only the published 1.29x negation-map factor it gives 2^128.580511.
The 179-instruction field multiplication and C=1000 are organizer normalization constants, not hardware timings.
